questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many passed the TGP? Six are shown, and others are mentioned (pp. 22-23).
Why were the others set aside, beyond the pinch-off rule (p. 12)?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example Stage 1 maps for devices B, C and D, and Vp below −1.1580 V for device B (p. 25)?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example a run of device A that failed the TGP, and how many runs of each device passed?
Does each pass survive when you rerun the released code on the measured data with a narrower field window, a smaller bias window, coarser Vp steps, or another subset of cutter pairs?
What are the maximum topological gaps once the 16% bias correction (p. 50) is applied, and how much do nonlocal sign changes (p. 25) move them?
Do zero-field gate scans of the junctions show Coulomb resonances above the gap, and does the A2 right-junction resonance (Fig. 13(d)) recur in other runs?
Have you measured an SOI2 with the field rotated away from the wire, or with the outer plungers stepped, to see whether the gap closing follows?
